name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Customer Success Manager | Mid-Market B2B SaaS, Project-Based Business Software, Executive Relationships
summary: Senior customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS. At Accelo I sold, scoped, and planned implementations of a CRM, project-management, and billing platform (PSA) for professional-services firms, including architecture and engineering firms, working directly with C-suite leaders. At Birdeye I used utilization signals to flag at-risk accounts early and retained all but one of 15-20 partners (~94%). At Solenzo I build CRM and automation systems for home-services trade businesses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), so I know how project- and field-based firms actually run.

Guide owners through the change from manual processes to automated workflows, documenting playbooks so the process scales.
